```{r setup}
source("R/cv_functions.R")
cv <- load_cv("data/cv.yml")
p  <- cv$person
today <- format(Sys.Date(), "%B %Y")
```

```{r header, results='asis'}
if (is_pdf()) {
  cat(glue("\\newcommand{{\\cvfootleft}}{{{today}}}\n\\newcommand{{\\cvfootcentre}}{{{p$name} · Résumé}}\n"))
  photo <- if (file.exists("images/photo.jpg")) "images/photo.jpg" else ""
  contact <- glue("\\faEnvelope\\ {p$email2} \\quad \\faPhone\\ {p$phone} \\quad \\faMapMarker\\ Guelph, Ontario \\quad ",
                  "\\faGlobe\\ {p$website} \\quad \\faLinkedin\\ {p$linkedin}")
  cat(glue("\\cvheader{{{p$name}}}{{Soil Scientist · Research and Project Lead}}{{PhD (Environmental Sciences), MBA, CIMA}}{{{contact}}}{{{p$profile_industry}}}{{{photo}}}\n"))
} else {
  out(glue("# {p$name}, {p$credentials}"))
  out("**Soil Scientist, Research and Project Lead**  ")
  out(glue("{p$email2} | {p$phone} | Guelph, Ontario | https://{p$website} | linkedin.com/in/{p$linkedin}"))
  out(glue("*{p$profile_industry}*"))
}
```

# Core competencies

```{r, results='asis'}
skills_section(cv)
```

# Professional experience

```{r, results='asis'}
positions_section(cv, keep = c(
  "Postdoctoral Research Scholar",
  "Chair, Bargaining Lead and Unit Grievance Officer",
  "Part-time Faculty",
  "Curriculum Developer",
  "Graduate Research Assistant and PhD Candidate",
  "Lecturer",
  "Personal Banking Officer"))
```

# Selected achievements

```{r, results='asis'}
bullet_list(list(
  "Co-developed and lead the isotope workstream of a CAD 239,572 OMAFA Tier 1 grassland carbon project and contributed to a CAD 228,335 NMR soil-health proposal.",
  "Delivered multi-season field campaigns across Ontario research sites with traceable sample archives, QA logs and reproducible R analysis pipelines.",
  "Brought a CFI/John R. Evans Leaders Fund research-infrastructure award to operational readiness (elemental analyser, root washer, ball mill), including procurement, safe workflows and user training.",
  "Elected Chair and Bargaining Lead for the University of Guelph postdoctoral unit; negotiate collective terms and resolve grievances with HR and academic leadership.",
  "Built two complete college curricula (Business Statistics, Climate Change Governance) and teach with a 4.7/5.0 evaluation average.",
  "First author of papers in Scientific Reports and Applied Geochemistry; six further first-author manuscripts in review; Top Cited Article recognition (2025).",
  "Completed Lab2Market Discover and Validate (NSERC/Mitacs) and designed a validation concept for a soil-health and salinity-risk dashboard."
))
```

# Education

```{r, results='asis'}
walk(cv$education, ~ out(glue("- **{.x$degree}**, {.x$institution}, {.x$start} to {.x$end}")))
```
